description.content:
Undocumented operations used by the Microsoft Defender XDR multi-tenant
organization portal at `mto.security.microsoft.com`.

This is a portal-view specification. Many operations wrap native Defender
XDR services beneath `/mtoapi/` so an operator can work across the tenants
available to their MTO scope. A route in this specification therefore does
not imply a separate backend implementation; it records the MTO transport,
selection context, response envelope, and portal workflow that agents need
to reproduce or troubleshoot the multi-tenant experience.

Native `security.microsoft.com` operations remain in the Defender XDR spec.
MTO-wrapped operations are kept here even when their result payload mirrors
a native Defender operation, avoiding duplicate ownership while preserving
the observable portal contract.
